# NEW 2026-11-18 territory rework, phase 1 (route C): province statuses. Generated by gen_territory_status.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Theme country scope. Tribute moved by script each month: a share of the monthly income by status,
# plus the senate's extra levy (BYZ var:oe_ts_levy_extra) for exarchates, chartered cities and despotates;
# a chartered city that voted against a forced levy (var:oe_tsn_objector) pays half of the extra.
oe_ts_tribute_amount = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_status ?= 3 } add = 0.1 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_status ?= 5 } add = 0.05 }
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = { var:oe_theme_status ?= 3 var:oe_theme_status ?= 4 var:oe_theme_status ?= 5 }
            country_exists = c:BYZ
            c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_ts_levy_extra }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tsn_objector } add = { value = c:BYZ.var:oe_ts_levy_extra multiply = 0.5 } }
        else = { add = c:BYZ.var:oe_ts_levy_extra }
    }
    multiply = monthly_income_total
    min = 0
}

# theme-tribute. Any scope: month index year x 12 + month (Nirvana's NIR_CIV_month_index form): the once-a-month
# guard, the founding month and the age of a theme.
oe_ts_month_index = { value = current_year multiply = 12 add = current_month }
# theme scope: months since the theme was founded (var:oe_te_founded, set with the first status); 999 when unknown
# (old saves: counted as past the grace, design 3.3)
oe_ts_trib_age = {
    value = 999
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_te_founded } value = oe_ts_month_index subtract = var:oe_te_founded }
}
# readouts (theme scope; 0 when not set): paid this month, due this month, paid the month before, months in
# arrears, unpaid gold
# TRIB_V2 = False in gen_territory_status.py: the remittance that sets this variable is not written; reads as not set
oe_ts_trib_last_v = { value = 0 }
oe_ts_trib_due_v = { value = 0 }
oe_ts_trib_prev_v = { value = 0 }
oe_ts_arrears_v = { value = 0 }
oe_ts_arrears_gold_v = { value = 0 }
# BYZ scope: remitted this calendar year (0 before the first remittance of the year)
# TRIB_V2 = False in gen_territory_status.py: the remittance that sets this variable is not written; reads as not set
oe_ts_trib_year_v = { value = 0 }
# TEST ONLY readouts (test buttons tribc2, triblog; theme scope)
oe_ts_trib_t_mb = { value = monthly_balance }
oe_ts_trib_t_inc = { value = monthly_income_total }
oe_ts_trib_t_gold = { value = gold }
oe_ts_trib_t_infl = { value = inflation }
oe_ts_trib_t_band = { value = -1 if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty_band } value = var:oe_theme_loyalty_band } }
oe_ts_trib_t_status = { value = -1 if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_status } value = var:oe_theme_status } }
oe_ts_trib_t_fiscal = { value = -1 if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_fiscal } value = var:oe_theme_fiscal } }
oe_ts_trib_t_adj = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_te_trib_adj } value = var:oe_te_trib_adj } }
oe_ts_trib_t_tq = { value = -1 if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tq_last } value = var:oe_tq_last } }
oe_ts_trib_t_month = { value = -1 }   # TRIB_V2 = False in gen_territory_status.py: the remittance that sets this variable is not written; reads as not set
# the crown's army pay to this theme as the first maker's payment counts it (price 1 gold, no inflation, x the slider)
oe_ts_trib_t_pay = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { oe_theme_army_payment_trigger = yes }
        if = { limit = { oe_pillars_naval_theme_trigger = yes } add = navy_size }
        else = { add = army_size }
        multiply = oe_theme_law_pay_ratio
    }
}
# tax base of the theme's own buildings' locations owned by the crown: the seat's location, the posts' locations
oe_ts_trib_t_seat = { value = 0 every_owned_foreign_building_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ oe_ts_trib_seat_loc = yes } add = location_tax_base } }
oe_ts_trib_t_post = { value = 0 every_owned_foreign_building_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ NOT = { oe_ts_trib_seat_loc = yes } } add = location_tax_base } }
